items.title: From Passivity to Self-Empowerment

body.text: Based on Empowerment Therapy learn a process to empower yourself when you are confused and distressed, and share it with your clients. It will help you to:

items: Foster self-connection to enhance your physical and emotional well-being.
Regain emotional equilibrium by allowing yourself to acknowledge and process distress.
Gain clarity about your needs in challenging situations.
Access your intuition to discover insights into how best to meet those needs.
Cultivate an inner refuge by finding a place of safety and rest within yourself .
Build resilience by processing pain as it arises rather than allowing it to accumulate over time.
Develop the confidence to ask for what you want, grounded in the energy and power of your needs.
Transform conflict into mutual understanding and find solutions that meet everyone’s needs.

Recognize the systems that affect your well-being and gradually free yourself from harmful dynamics while preserving security, connection, and belonging with the people and groups that matter to you..

items.presenter: Myra Walden, MA Clinical Psychology, NVC Certified Trainer
